question: Should the platform migrate from the monolith to service-per-domain now?

claims.text: Domain boundaries in the monolith are already well isolated.
Splitting services will reduce blast radius of failures.
The migration pays for itself within four quarters.
Teams can ship independently after the split.
Per-service auth boundaries improve the security posture.
Now is the right time to begin the migration.

positions.note: Module dependency graph is mostly acyclic already.
Shared DB tables are the only real coupling.
